propositions: Bare-repository fixtures fail under safe.bareRepository=explicit because generic helpers route commands through cwd=<bare> or git -C <bare>, triggering implicit bare discovery rejection instead of explicit repository targeting.

The failure occurs during fixture setup before test bodies run: git config gc.autoDetach false fails with 'not in a git directory' (rc 128) and git symbolic-ref HEAD fails with 'cannot use bare repository' (rc 128).

Root cause is confirmed via runtime evidence: implicit cwd and git -C invocations return rc 128 under strict config; identical commands with top-level --git-dir return 0; default implicit controls return 0; worktree -C invocations remain valid.

The repair explicitly targets bare repositories using --git-dir at test helper call sites and in infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py::_verify_restore without changing Git safety settings or weakening fail-fast behavior.

Sibling bare-repository commands across 12 test files and the production restore path are semantically inventoried and repaired; deliberate safe.bareRepository=all exceptions in external workflows remain untouched.
Tests pass under both isolated safe.bareRepository=explicit and isolated default-config controls; held-out oracle verifies exact fixture initialization behavior and rules out unrelated Git errors.
